description: This file contains unit tests for the absl container internal raw_hash_set, focusing on allocator propagation behaviors, including custom allocators and their interactions during copy, move, swap, and construction.

classes.name: CheckedAlloc
classes.description: A custom allocator that tracks allocations and deallocations, with propagation traits based on specified behavior.

classes.name: PAlloc
classes.description: A polymorphic-like allocator with no propagation on swap, similar to std::pmr::polymorphic_allocator.

methods.name: select_on_container_copy_construction
methods.description: Returns a copy of the allocator for copy construction.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the contents of two allocators.
